settings.title: Why it works
settings.text:
While you sleep, your face presses and folds and your skin loses moisture, so lines set in deeper. Each patch does two things all night: it holds the skin smooth so it can't crease, and it seals in your skin's own moisture. Peel it off in the morning and your lines look ironed out.

No needles, no actives, nothing absorbed. Just soft silicone doing its job for 6–8 hours.

settings.title: How to use
settings.text:
• Prep: start with clean, fully dry skin. No serum, lotion or oil underneath.
  • Apply: press each patch on from the center out so it lies flat. Don't stretch the skin around the eyes.
  • Sleep: wear them overnight, 6–8 hours. Side sleeper? Press the edges once more before lights out.
  • Morning: peel off gently, then just clean and reuse. Store each patch on its backing film.

settings.question: Will the patches stay on all night?
settings.answer: Applied to clean, fully dry skin (no serum or oil underneath), the patches are made to stay in place overnight. Smooth each one from the center outward so it sits flat, and press the edges once more if you sleep on your side.

settings.question: How many times can I reuse them?
settings.answer: Many nights with proper care. Clean each patch after use and store it on its backing film. How long they last depends on your skin prep and care routine.

settings.question: Will they irritate my skin or cause breakouts?
settings.answer: The patches are soft silicone with no actives; nothing is absorbed into your skin. Keep them clean between uses. If your skin is sensitive, try one for an hour first.

settings.question: Does it work on deep lines?
settings.answer: You'll see smoother-looking softening. Fine lines respond most; deep-set lines soften less. We'd rather tell you that now than surprise you later.

settings.question: How long should I wear them?
settings.answer: Overnight, 6–8 hours is the sweet spot. Put them on right before bed and peel them off when you wake up.

settings.question: How soon will I see results?
settings.answer: Most people see smoother-looking skin the very first morning. The look is strongest in the first hours after you peel them off, and mornings keep starting smoother when you use them regularly.
